The blue frontage edge is answered by a visible open side/court rather than a sealed wall, so the ground threshold is semantically aligned. The form is not especially rich in section: the roofline is mostly flat and the upper mass does not strongly express the neighborhood-living requirements for active ground + public void + calmer upper hierarchy. Still, as an early massing diagram it plausibly supports compact neighborhood living and does not collapse into a different typology. Main weakness is the somewhat arbitrary hollow/roof relationship, plus the stair-step/cut appearance is not yet fully justified as a capacity-bearing terrace section.
